rawCommits.subject: Raise remote-agent turn and cold-open timeouts
rawCommits.body:
Long but actively-progressing remote agent turns were tripping the sliding-idle turn_timeout (180s) and the hard 60s cold-open cap, surfacing as spurious stalls/502s when waking a hibernated microVM or running long tool/LLM work.

Raise DEFAULT_MAX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS 180->600 and DEFAULT_FIRST_EVENT_TIMEOUT_SECS 180->300, and make the cold-open cap configurable (AURA_COLD_OPEN_TIMEOUT_SECS, default 180) instead of a hardcoded 60s.

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): stop full-transcript re-render on every keystroke
rawCommits.body:
The error agent/device context hook returned a fresh object literal each render. Threaded through ChatSurface into every React.memo'd MessageBubble, this defeated memoization so the whole transcript re-parsed markdown on every draft keystroke and streaming token, causing the recent app-wide messaging slowdown.

- Memoize useErrorReportAgentInfo on its resolved primitive fields so the reference is stable across keystrokes.

- Memoize ChatMessageList and stabilize the emptyState prop so draft input changes no longer re-run the transcript map.

- Honor OS prefers-reduced-motion for the always-on attach-button halo/spin animations on every authenticated chat.

- Restore the existing formatter tests and add memoization regression tests.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: stop full-transcript re-render on every keystroke

rawCommits.subject: perf(agents): cut idle GPU cost of the 3D profile card
rawCommits.body:
The agent profile card ran a full THREE.js + UnrealBloom composite every frame for the entire time it was mounted, pausing only when the whole tab was backgrounded. On integrated GPUs and high-DPI displays this sustained GPU load could throttle the system and make the rest of the app feel slow.

- Drop antialias on the renderer: it allocated a multisampled framebuffer that the EffectComposer bypasses, for zero visual gain.

- Halt the render loop under prefers-reduced-motion once hover/flip transitions settle (idle is fully static there), instead of compositing bloom every frame.

- Re-add an off-screen pause via IntersectionObserver, guarding the spurious 0x0 first-callback that previously could freeze a visible card; resume respects both tab visibility and on-screen state.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: perf(agents): cut idle GPU cost of the 3D profile card

rawCommits.subject: fix(analytics): keep app_version on server session_active
rawCommits.body: Server-emitted session_active is deduped to the first authenticated request per user per UTC day. A header-less request (native WebSocket / ticket redeem, or the synthetic capture-demo-user) could win that slot and land the day's event on Mixpanel's app_version = "(not set)" slice. - Remember the latest non-empty X-App-Version / X-App-Platform per user and fall back to it when the triggering request omits the headers, so the daily session_active always carries a real version. - Skip session_active entirely for capture-mode tokens, which otherwise add a fake DAU user with no version. Co-authored-by: Cursor

rawCommits.subject: fix(marketing): stop WebGL page background flickering on resize

The full-screen ScreenOrbBackground / FlowFieldBackground reallocated and
cleared the WebGL drawing buffer inside a ResizeObserver but only repainted
when the rAF loop was stopped (`if (!raf) renderFrame()`). Since raf is
always active while animating, the cleared (black) buffer got composited for
a frame before the next tick redrew it, producing a flicker on every resize
step. Repaint synchronously after each resize so the cleared buffer is never
shown.

rendered.title: Public whitepaper, fully localized marketing, and chat performance fixes
rendered.intro: A big day for the public surface of Aura: the /os whitepaper grew from a single Harness outline into a multi-repo reference with diagrams and GitHub-linked code, the marketing site picked up real Terms and Privacy pages plus translations into 19 languages, and the trust card's "Always on." switch became a real animated control. Underneath, chat got noticeably snappier, long-running remote agent turns stopped timing out, and the dev server stopped locking itself into infinite error loops.

entries.title: Theme-aware mode selector capsule
entries.summary: The input bar's mode selector now picks up the active theme accent instead of a hardcoded glow.

items.text: Repainted the mode selector capsule and selected-mode label using the theme accent token, and softened the selected-state glow so it sits naturally in both light and dark themes.
Stabilized the eval suite by seeding the Run sidekick tab and mocking transient remote state probes, so CI assertions stay deterministic across runs.

entries.title: Longer remote-agent turn and cold-open budgets
entries.summary: Remote agents waking from hibernation or doing long tool/LLM work no longer trip spurious idle and cold-open timeouts.

items.text: Raised the sliding idle turn timeout from 180s to 600s and the first-event timeout from 180s to 300s, and made the cold-open cap configurable via AURA_COLD_OPEN_TIMEOUT_SECS (default 180s) instead of a hardcoded 60s — eliminating the stalls and 502s that surfaced when waking a hibernated microVM.

entries.title: Chat typing latency and idle GPU cost fixes
entries.summary: Two targeted performance fixes remove the recent app-wide messaging slowdown and stop the agent profile card from heating up integrated GPUs.

items.text: Stopped the full chat transcript from re-parsing markdown on every keystroke and streaming token by memoizing the error-report agent info hook and the ChatMessageList, restoring memoization across React.memo'd MessageBubbles.

Cut idle GPU cost of the 3D agent profile card by dropping a wasted multisampled framebuffer, halting the bloom render loop once hover/flip transitions settle under prefers-reduced-motion, and pausing the scene off-screen via IntersectionObserver.
Honored the OS prefers-reduced-motion setting for the always-on attach-button halo and spin animations in authenticated chats.

entries.title: Whitepaper rework, full marketing localization, and the Always-on trust card
entries.summary: The public /os whitepaper was restructured with diagrams and GitHub-linked code refs, the marketing site shipped in 19 new languages, and the trust card's switch became a real interaction.

items.text: Reworked the /os AURA Harness whitepaper around per-section summaries, Overview bullets, and ASCII architecture diagrams; renamed the nav group to "AURA Harness"; and turned inline crate/file/function tokens into GitHub links into cypher-asi/aura-harness.

Added a dedicated Invariants section covering the fifteen §1–§15 architectural invariants, plus per-layer Internals diagrams, a request-lifecycle diagram, and detailed sequence diagrams for the interactive, run-kickoff, headless, error-recovery, and data-lifecycle flows.

Pointed the dev /os whitepaper at the prod public-content host so local development renders real seeded content instead of the empty state, generalizing the existing blog helpers to serve both surfaces.

Translated the public marketing and publicChat namespaces into all 19 non-English locales (including expertise detail pages and the rotating tagline), and added reproducible machine-translation and placeholder-validation scripts so the catalogs stay in sync with English.

Turned the "Always on." trust card switch into a clickable, sequenced animation — the knob slides and the ON label fades back in on the open side — and tightened the card copy so it wraps like its siblings.

Polished the marketing surface: centered the trust display panel between the device and card edge, restyled the footer copyright as a column-aligned badge, stopped the full-screen WebGL backgrounds from flickering on resize, and let the trust disc, verified cubes, and paint gallery keep their ambient motion under prefers-reduced-motion.

Added a remembered-accounts dropdown to the Sign In screen: previously-used emails are persisted to localStorage (capped at five, most-recent first) with an "Add an account" option and per-entry forget.

Fixed analytics' daily session_active so it always carries the real app_version and platform — falling back to the latest non-empty header per user and skipping capture-mode tokens entirely so they no longer pollute DAU with "(not set)".

entries.title: Vite 8 dev console-forwarding loop disabled
entries.summary: Local development no longer locks up before React mounts when Vite is spawned by an AI agent.

items.text: Disabled Vite 8's auto-enabled console forwarding in dev, which had been latching onto a never-connected websocket and turning every forwarded error into an infinite re-forwarding loop. Also kept three.js out of the entry-critical vendor chunk via a manualChunks split.

entries.title: Whitepaper covers five core repos, legal pages ship, and Agents view stops landing on dead agents
entries.summary: The /os whitepaper now spans the full AURA stack, /terms and /privacy got real localized content with the standard marketing chrome, and the standalone Agents view stops getting stuck on stale or local agents.

items.text: Extended the /os whitepaper beyond AURA Harness to aura-os, aura-router, aura-network, aura-storage, and z-billing — each rendered as its own collapsible nav group with per-section summaries, architecture and internals diagrams — and made inline code-ref links repo-aware so they resolve to the correct cypher-asi/<repo>.

Tightened the /os reading experience: dropped the sidebar's nested scrollbar now that the nav lists every repo, stopped the brief "no content yet" flash by gating empty states on each query's isFetched.

Replaced the placeholder /terms and /privacy heroes with full CYPHER, INC. (Nevada) legal documents rendered through a shared LegalDocument component, machine-translated into all 20 locales, and folded into the standard hero / changelog preview / CTA / footer marketing stack with a matching black background.

Refined the "Always on." toggle animation across several passes: the ON label now smoothly fades in place while the knob glides on a compositor-driven translateX, returning sooner on the opposite side without the earlier snap.

Fixed the standalone Agents view so it no longer lands on a dead agent after login: cached last-agent IDs are cleared on logout, validated against the loaded fleet before redirecting, and stale IDs bounce back to /agents. The destination chat history is also warmed on click and post-login redirect to avoid the cold-load gate flash.

Hid local (desktop-bridge-only) agents from the browser's agent list, favorites strip, and standalone deep-link resolution when running remote-only, so the web client only surfaces agents it can actually use.

Broadened the English marketing source catalog via a one-time i18n bootstrap script that pulls previously-hardcoded strings (including expertise entries and discipline pills) out of components, then re-translated the expanded catalog into every supported locale.

highlights: /os whitepaper expanded to cover five core repos with diagrams and GitHub-linked code refs
Full marketing site, Terms, and Privacy translated into 20 locales
Chat transcript no longer re-renders on every keystroke
Remote agent cold-starts and long turns stop hitting spurious 60s/180s timeouts
Login screen now remembers up to five recent accounts
